verdict.rationale: Sierra's first-party docs say its voice agent speaks over 55 languages, with Voice Personas tuned across 59 languages / 60+ locales, so multilingual customer conversations are clearly claimed for voice. Nothing shows the agent answering in other languages from an English-only knowledge base, or multilingual support on chat, email, or SMS. Missing for 10: evidence of cross-lingual grounding on English-only knowledge content, multilingual support on non-voice channels, independent or hands-on corroboration of language quality.
